adjudication.rationale: In app/views/layouts/embed.html.erb the code calls `parent.postMessage(..., '<%= request.referer %>')`. `request.referer` is a full URL (including path/query) and can also be blank/odd; `postMessage`’s `targetOrigin` is supposed to be an origin (scheme+host+port) or `"*"`. Passing a full referer URL means the browser’s origin check won’t match (or may error for invalid/empty), so the resize message can fail and the origin restriction is effectively mis-specified. This is directly introduced by the new inline JS in the diff.
